name: print-social-remarketing-stock-photo-icon-overlay-1
title: Office stock photo overlaid with remarketing icon hexagons
whatItIs: A desk scene of coworkers reviewing charts, overlaid with a translucent hexagonal icon network and the word REMARKETING glowing in cyan.
whatItMeans: Layering abstract data icons over a real photo grounds an intangible concept (digital marketing) in a relatable human moment, a common technique for B2B blog headers.
techniques: overlay a glowing icon network atop a photo to visualize an abstract digital concept
connect icons with thin lines radiating from a central glowing keyword
desaturate the underlying photo slightly so the overlay graphics pop forward

vocabulary.definition: a semi-transparent graphic layer placed on top of a photograph to add conceptual or data information
